stops.title: The call and return
stops.text: God revealed his Son to Paul, who went to Arabia and then returned to Damascus.

stops.title: Meeting the apostles
stops.text: Paul visits Peter and James after three years, and again fourteen years later with Barnabas and Titus to lay out the gospel he preaches.

stops.title: Syria and Cilicia
stops.text: Paul spent years in these regions, unknown by sight to the churches of Judea.

stops.title: Confronting Peter
stops.text: Peter withdraws from eating with Gentile believers, and Paul opposes him to his face.

stops.title: The churches of Galatia
stops.text: The churches Paul writes to; their exact location is debated.

stops.title: Mount Sinai in Arabia
stops.text: In his Hagar and Sarah picture, Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia.
